# Position and entries

Read the state of the open position, its individual entries and recent positions. An index argument usually counts back: 0 is the current position or entry, 1 the one before.

[Back to the keyword reference index](README.md)

### AvgEntryPrice

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Average fill price of the entries that make up the open position; 0 when flat.

```easylanguage
Vars: Gain(0);
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
If MarketPosition = 1 Then Gain = Close - AvgEntryPrice;
```

### ExitDate

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | numeric | at least 1 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

EL date on which the position the given number of positions ago was closed. `ExitDate(1)` is the most recent closed position.
